newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: EKRANAS NOT TO PAY 1996 DIVIDENDS.
newsitem.headline: EKRANAS NOT TO PAY 1996 DIVIDENDS.

text.p: Lithuanian electronics company Ekranas decided at its shareholder meeting on Wednesday not to pay dividends from its 1996 net profit of 45.6 million litas, a company spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said that the meeting decided to put all the profits into investments, to boost turnover and upgrade the company's production line.
The company said that its net profit was 45.6 million litas in 1996 versus 13.75 million litas loss in 1995.

Ekranas wanted to increase its share capital by 39 million litas from revaluation reserves but the main shareholder of the company, Swiss Farimex, which has 44 percent of the firm, was against the move and the share capital rise was not considered.
The share capital of the firm is 113 million litas.
The spokeswoman said that Farimex in essence approved the share capital rise but thinks that it should happen later with a new share issue.
Farimex has not said when it wants the share issue to happen.
